terrain.operational_rule: Terrain is static and target-independent. It is not requested as a daily real-time observation.

causality.target_date_rule: Only observations available on or before the target prediction date may be used.
causality.label_usage: Labels are never prediction inputs. Historical labels may only be used after inference for demonstration or post-hoc comparison.

smap_alignment.rule: Use the latest SMAP observation on or before the target date.

missing_data.general: Missing observations must be represented explicitly and handled by the locked M11 preprocessing pipeline.
missing_data.live_api_missing_response: Validation failure or explicitly incomplete input; never silently substitute fabricated observations.
missing_data.smap: If no valid causal SMAP observation exists within the 7-day maximum age, the observation remains unavailable.

date: no future observation relative to target date
validation.district: Must belong to the model's locked district list.
numeric_values: not NaN where contract requires a value
validation.duplicates: Duplicate observations for the same district/date/variable combination must be detected.
validation.chronology: Historical sequences must be ordered chronologically before sequence construction.
validation.sequence_history: Prediction cannot proceed until the complete required 15-day Flood or 30-day Landslide causal window has been constructed.

source_abstraction.principle: The M12 inference engine is source-independent. External providers must be converted into the standardized M12 input contract before inference.
source_abstraction.provider_specific_logic: Must remain inside source adapters and must not change the M11 model or preprocessing contract.
